description: This file implements Netlink socket communication, including serialization, deserialization, sending, and receiving Netlink messages, with support for debugging and thread safety mechanisms.

classes.name: Netlink
classes.description: Handles serialization and deserialization of Netlink messages, maintains sequence ID.

classes.name: SocketNetlink
classes.description: Manages sending and receiving Netlink messages over sockets, thread-safe with locking, supports debugging.

methods.name: Netlink::Serialize
methods.description: Serializes Netlink message into a byte stream.

methods.name: Netlink::Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a byte stream into Netlink message fields.

methods.name: SocketNetlink::SendData
methods.description: Prepares data for sending over socket, with optional debugging output.

methods.name: SocketNetlink::ReceiveData
methods.description: Processes received data from socket, updating pending messages or deserializing.

methods.name: SocketNetlink::StateChange
methods.description: Placeholder for signaling state changes (e.g., open, close).
